response.overview: Agyu from Ayuman is one of Pamulaw’s 3 sons. He heads the household and his family's livelihood of trading beeswax and honey. One day, they had a misunderstanding with the leader of Moros— sparking wars between them even when they travelled to the kingdom of Nalandangan. Each encounter, Agyu wins with his strategic leadership. In the end, they find peace in Nalandangan where his family and his people finally stayed.
response.title: Wetsitales: Agyu from Ayuman
